class.name: HDWIGPIOResource
class.brief_description: Virtual GPIO chip - a bank of digital lines the FSW can read, write, and set direction on.
class.description:
Models one GPIO chip ([code]gpiochip[/code]) exposed to the flight software. The chip has N lines; line state lives in [member gpio_values] (index = line offset). The FSW can drive a line ([code]GPIO_SET[/code]), read a line ([code]GPIO_GET[/code]), or change its direction ([code]GPIO_DIR_IN[/code] / [code]GPIO_DIR_OUT[/code]). [b]How to interface[/b] [olist] [*]Set [member chip_index] (the natural id the kernel uses to route to this chip) and seed [member gpio_values] with the initial line levels - its size defines the line count. [*]Call [method HDWIResource.init] to register the chip. [*]Connect [signal on_gpio_line_change] to observe lines the FSW drives, and [signal HDWIResource.on_send] to forward read responses to the kernel socket. [*]To present a sensor/input value to the FSW, write [member gpio_values]; the next [code]GPIO_GET[/code] returns the current level at that offset. [/olist] [b]Example[/b] [codeblock] var gpio = HDWIGPIOResource.new() gpio.device_name = "gpiochip0" gpio.chip_index = 0 gpio.gpio_values = PackedInt32Array([0, 0, 0, 0]) # 4 lines, all low gpio.init()
gpio.on_gpio_line_change.connect(_on_line_change) gpio.on_send.connect(_write_to_kernel_socket)
func _on_line_change(line_offset, new_value): print("FSW drove line %d to %d" % [line_offset, new_value])
# Present an external high signal on line 2 to the FSW: var v = gpio.gpio_values v[2] = 1 gpio.gpio_values = v # also fires on_gpio_line_change for changed lines [/codeblock]

method.name: get_group_type_representation
method.description: Builds the GPIO section of the [code]CMD_SYNCH[/code] registration body: [code][type][count][/code] followed by every registered chip's device representation. Called by the registry during sync.

method.name: lookup_gpio_device_id
method.description: Returns the 0-based slot of the chip with the given [member chip_index] in the internal registry, or [code]-1[/code] if no such chip is registered.

members.member: Natural identifier of this chip on the wire (inner GPIO header [code]chip_index[/code]). The registry uses it to route incoming packets to this resource.
Per-line logic levels (0/1), indexed by line offset. The array size is the number of lines on the chip. Assigning a new array emits [signal on_gpio_line_change] for every line whose value changed.

signal.name: on_gpio_line_change
signal.description: Emitted when a line's level changes - either because the FSW issued [code]GPIO_SET[/code], or because GDScript reassigned [member gpio_values]. Use it to drive scene visuals or downstream logic.
